source: livewire lake on macmini: ~/market-warehouse/data-lake/bronze/asset_class=equity/symbol=SPY/{1m,1d}.parquet. 1m bar_timestamp is TIMESTAMPTZ in Asia/Hong_Kong, extended hours, ~850 bars per HKT date; filtered to 09:30-16:00 America/New_York and normalised to UTC here. 1d keys on trade_date (a DATE, no clock).
